failed_attempts.after_stash_launcher_cause: stash apply materialized the POSIX script with CRLF before restoring the previously untracked eol attribute; normalized exact HEAD bytes again. Final attribute must be included with eventual commit.
failed_attempts.loopback_diagnostic: Independent stdlib localhost probe reproduced WinError 10048 after 39 successful requests and WinError 10055 on bind; not confined to U1/U2. The later 1000-request baseline probe succeeded before sequential closeout suites. No system settings changed. Specific OS-level cause is unconfirmed; low observed TCP counts do not establish ephemeral port exhaustion.
failed_attempts.probe_approval: First elevated diagnostic not executed due automatic review deadline; one permitted retry succeeded.
failed_attempts.cause: core.autocrlf=true with unspecified POSIX launcher eol; fixed by exact-path eol attribute and byte normalization
failed_attempts.optional_test_import: isolated missing-U2 and simulated-old-Python failure reproduced before guards
failed_attempts.missing_temp_parents: isolated fresh-checkout reproduction, without deleting historical directories
